description: Software dashboard that collects and tracks astronaut health data—such as radiation levels, bone density, and stress—so crew members can independently monitor and manage their well-being during long space missions.
summary:
ORBITAL CARE – Monitoring Human Health Beyond Earth
ORBITAL CARE is a web-based astronaut health-monitoring application designed to monitor and visualize the physiological conditions of astronauts during space missions. The application provides a centralized dashboard to manage multiple missions and astronauts, allowing users to view individual health parameters and spacecraft cabin conditions. It monitors important physiological indicators such as heart rate, blood pressure, blood oxygen saturation, respiratory rate and body temperature. The backend is integrated with Google Firebase Firestore, which stores mission details, astronaut information and continuously updated health readings. JavaScript-based simulation generates changing health parameters at regular intervals, which are supplied to the application for monitoring and visualization. Interactive graphs, health status indicators and alerts help identify variations in monitored parameters. The application is designed with an expandable database structure, allowing new missions and astronauts to be added dynamically. ORBITAL CARE aims to provide an accessible, organized and scalable platform for exploring astronaut health monitoring and supporting future spaceflight healthcare systems.
details:
ORBITAL CARE is a web-based astronaut health-monitoring application designed to monitor astronauts during space missions. It displays important health parameters such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate and body temperature. It also provides mission management, astronaut profiles, cabin-condition monitoring, graphs and alerts.

The application uses JavaScript to generate simulated health readings at regular intervals. Google Firebase Firestore is connected to store and continuously supply the data to the application dashboard. The interface displays updated readings through graphs, health indicators and alerts.

The project is developed using React, JavaScript and Firebase. Its main objective is to provide a simple and centralized platform for monitoring multiple astronauts. Its expandable design allows users to add new missions and astronauts easily. ORBITAL CARE demonstrates how web technologies and cloud databases can support future space-health monitoring systems.
